name: Lorem Picsum
summary: Placeholder photo service: add a size to the URL and get a random image, with seed, id, grayscale and blur options.
description: An image placeholder service — the Lorem Ipsum for photos. Append a width and height to the URL for a random photo, /seed/{seed} for a stable one or /id/{id} for a specific image, and combine ?grayscale and ?blur; a /v2/list endpoint returns image metadata with pagination and /id/{id}/info gives per-image details.
contains: specific image via /id/{id}, stable random image via /seed/{seed}
/v2/list endpoint, 30 images per page, page and limit parameters
